text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are posting modest identical gains of 0.6% over 24 hours while smaller caps like SOL outpace them slightly, suggesting cautious incremental buying rather than broad conviction. Fear & Greed sentiment has shifted into greed territory at 69 and is climbing, though Bitcoin's 59.5% dominance indicates the market is still anchored to the largest asset rather than chasing alts. Total volume of $43B is moderate, pointing to steady but unhurried accumulation without the explosive moves typical of euphoric markets.
